paper.title: Densification of cellulose acetate-derived porous carbons for enhanced volumetric hydrogen adsorption performance

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Tables 1-3): 16 rows, 0 numeric disputes. Inventory confirmed (7 Char/KOH ratios + 5 heating times + CA powder/pellet + ZIF-8 powder/pellet); the Table 3 CA feedstock (2.55 wt%) is kept separate from the Table 1 1:2 optimum (2.80 wt%), no conflation. Parenthetical micropore vs primary total pore volumes not swapped; pellet density/volumetric-capacity pairs not transposed (CA 0.80 g/cm3 & 20.3 g-H2/L; ZIF-8 0.54 & 11.6); g-H2/L->kg/m3 carried 1:1. CA-derived=activated_carbon/chemical_activation; ZIF-8-derived=other/pyrolysis; uptake_type=unspecified (the Table 4 'total' superscript applies only to the ref-14 comparison values, not this work's 20.3). All 77 K/1 bar. Agent C: S14 activation_method trimmed to the KOH-activation clause (die-compaction is densification, already in material_description); all 16 Tier B upheld -- Agent B's conservative C for M1/M2 declined because validate.py grades the Chahine point to 1 (within 1.5x expected) and S13.5 credits the paper's stated narrow-micropore mechanism; the H2 apparatus is described in the ESI.

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper says 'hydrogen adsorption'/'H2 uptake'/'gravimetric H2 storage density'; neither 'excess' nor 'total' is used for its values
notes.cond: all H2 values are at -196 C (77 K) and 1 bar
notes.tex: bet_surface_area=SBET (BET, P/P0 0.05-0.3); total_pore_volume=Vtotal (single-point at P/P0=0.96); micropore_volume=Vmicro (QSDFT cumulative, the parenthetic value); pore_volume_method=QSDFT (describes Vmicro), probe N2
notes.ca: cellulose-acetate-derived char, KOH chemical activation -> class=activated_carbon, synthesis_method=chemical_activation; precursor is a hydrothermal char of cellulose acetate
notes.zif: ZIF-8(MOF)-derived carbon, prepared by carbonization of the ZIF-8 framework (comparison material); class=other (a MOF-derived carbon, not matching activated/templated), synthesis_method=pyrolysis
notes.pellet: the pellet is the powder compacted at 800 MPa with ~10 wt% PVA binder (die molding); still the same carbon (binder is a processing aid), recorded with packing_density and volumetric_capacity (per packed volume)
notes.vol: volumetric_capacity_kg_m3 = the volumetric H2 density in g-H2/L (=kg/m3): CA pellet 20.3, ZIF-8 pellet 11.6; volumetric_capacity_basis=packing_volume (per pellet bulk volume)
notes.method: H2 adsorption isotherms at -196 C (gas sorption analyser; the specific instrument is in the unavailable ESI) -> measurement_method=volumetric_sieverts
notes.onebar: Chahine caveat: 77 K/1 bar, below the saturation-bound regime; chahine scored a by-hand 1 (tiering doc); Tier B/C by the rubric otherwise
notes.series: an activation-optimisation series: Table 1 varies the Char/KOH ratio (at 700 C) and Table 2 varies the heating time (at 600 C, Char/KOH 1:2); all are distinct CA-derived activated carbons
